trait.name: Ephemeral
entries: The wisp can't wear or carry anything.

trait.name: Illumination
entries: The wisp sheds {@variantrule Bright Light|SRD52} in a 20-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|SRD52} for an additional 20 feet.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The wisp can move through other creatures and objects as if they were {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|SRD52}. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Variable Illumination
entries: The will-o'-wisp sheds bright light in a 5 to 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional number of ft. equal to the chosen radius. The will-o'-wisp can alter the radius as a bonus action.

bonus.name: Consume Life
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 10}, one living creature the wisp can see within 5 feet that has 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52}. {@actSaveFail} The target dies, and the wisp regains 10 ({@dice 3d6}) {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52}.

bonus.name: Vanish
entries: The wisp and its light have the {@condition Invisible|SRD52} condition until the wisp's {@status Concentration|SRD52} ends on this effect, which ends early immediately after the wisp makes an attack roll or uses Consume Life.

entries.name: Will-o'-Wisp
entries: {@i Guide on the Path to Doom}

From a distance, will-o'-wisps look like lanterns bobbing in the dark. Through the windows of abandoned structures or around the bends of treacherous paths, these spirits tempt the curious into peril. Once their prey is vulnerable, will-o'-wisps feed on the life force of those they lay low.
Roll on or choose a result from the Will-o'-Wisp Ambushes table to inspire how a will-o'-wisp imperils its victims.

entries.caption: Will-o'-Wisp Ambushes
rows: An abandoned structure ready to collapse.
An ambush by hungry ghouls or vampires.
A dreaded ruin that curses those who enter.
The lair of a predator, like a bear or wyvern.
Patches of brown mold or green slime.
Quicksand or pools covered in thin ice.
